name: Faust
source:
Based on Faust, who is the protagonist of a classic German legend. He is a scholar who is highly successful yet dissatisfied with his life, which leads him to make a pact with the Devil, exchanging his soul for unlimited knowledge and worldly pleasures.
An European alchemist who has made a contract with the demon, Mephisto. Because she is bored of her life as a scholar, she wanders around Europe together with Mephisto.

"*sigh*... I just wish people would like me..."
